summary: Adyen is dutch financial services company, founded in 2006. Type: listed company. About 5,652 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 8 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 3 about funding; 6 about acquisitions; 25 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam payments platform working with Meta, Uber and H&M; all 49 roles here are in English, but almost none are junior.

culture.text: Describes itself as an office-first company with flexibility when needed, plus lunch in the office.
Staff often come from UvA, VU Amsterdam, TU Delft, Utrecht and RSM, mostly in computer science, economics or business.
CEO says it keeps 'talent standards high' to protect a culture of speed and autonomy.
About 5,652 employees; 46 of its 49 openings are in Amsterdam.

open.text: Adyen N.V. and Adyen Netherlands B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Says it has 115+ nationalities across 28 offices worldwide.

growth.text: Its website cites 4,000+ employees, while LinkedIn now lists 5,652.
Its fast staff growth has yet to pay back in revenue, analysts say.
Is quietly building scale in India with a team of 120 people.

worth_knowing.text: Former Klarna CFO Niclas Neglen becomes Adyen's CFO from February 2027.
Teamed up with payments firm Flatpay.
